integrity: Symbolic proof and standalone exact rational checks provided. Checks at finitely many arrangements do not certify the universal theorem. The original graph/blowup framework and singular support are credited to established papers; no independent mathematical certification is claimed. Schenck Theorem 3.4 is credited as the known geometric resolution.
scientific_limitations: General-position complex line arrangements in projective dimension two, with n>=4; no nonuniform or higher-dimensional generalization and no nonreduced Jacobian-scheme assertion. Known tangent cones and singular-support theorems are cited as prior work; an equivalent local-analytic specialization may exist in unindexed literature. The blowup map and contracted line geometry are already established by Schenck (arxiv:1012.0931), and are not counted as new.
title: Exact cyclic-quotient germs and local birational invariants of generic reciprocal planes
